statement: An engaged operation-ledger formation barrier releases within its budget when ledger spread is achievable: the joiner's awaitOperationLedgerFormationBarrier (src/bootstrap/node-joining-operation-ledger-formation-readiness.js) stops oscillating and reaches SATISFIED once replica_operations-p1 genuinely reaches 3 voters on 3 distinct nodes, and the spread operations' execution edge gains formation-time relief so their own progress cannot starve forever against the concentrated seed-led ledger they exist to spread. Verified at HEAD 788682214 (live 3-node runs + code trace): greens are exactly the runs where the barrier never engages (guard returns; engaged release is arithmetically >=500ms, observed green joins are 4-8ms); when engaged, red-run barrier logs oscillate between waiting_for_ledger_spread and waiting_for_ledger_observation with observedVoterCount=3 via owner_rpc_lane but spreadProofComplete flapping true/false and inFlightOperationCount null, never satisfying all release legs in one iteration across the full 120s budget; spread REPLACE/ADD ops defer retryable-forever (DISTRIBUTED_PARTICIPANT_FAILURE progress writes routed through the concentrated ledger + seed-led write-session tables; STOPPING observation control_plane_pressure_degraded deferRetry with no escalation), and the admission hold policy simultaneously judges the same concentrated ledger not actionable (feasibility scan counts only connection_state=ready while placement eligibility accepts JOINING) — two owners disagreeing about actionability. The July interlock fixes (self-move ghost re-verify; drainPhaseReplacementCredit) are wired but cover different shapes. Fail-closed cases (two-node bypass, sequential growth, durable rejoin) must stay fail-closed.
